intro: The file everything else inherits from. Twelve questions, about twenty minutes. Answer as if an agent will act on it — because one will.

ask.help: Specific enough that an agent could disqualify someone. "Mid-market" is not a segment; a revenue band and a trigger is.
ask.example: Home cooks who already buy organic and have started reading past the label

ask.q: What do they suspect or struggle with that you can name better than they can?
ask.example: They suspect "organic" stopped meaning much and can't tell which brands actually farm differently

ask.q: What category are you in, in their words?
ask.help: The shelf they'd look on. Not the category you wish existed.
One sentence. If it needs an "and," you have two brands.

ask.q: Unlike whom — and what do you do that they don't?
Three proofs you can actually keep the promise.
ask.help: Things a skeptic could verify. A number, a document, a name. Not adjectives.

ask.q: What does this positioning cost you?
ask.help: Every real position closes a door. Naming it here is what stops someone reopening it next quarter.
A person in a situation, not a list of adjectives.
ask.example: A farmer explaining something to a neighbor who asked a good question

ask.help: Name the category default you're refusing. Include specific banned words.

ask.q: Five pairs: what we'd say, and the version we wouldn't.
ask.help: The most useful thing in the file. This is a classifier an agent can run a draft against.

ask.q: How do you sound when the news is bad?
ask.help: Stockout, price increase, outage. Most brands have no answer and default to chirpy.

ask.q: Describe an asset that looks wrong.
ask.help: Be concrete. This is how an agent knows it reached for the category default instead of your library.
ask.example: Kraft paper texture, hand-lettered script, a mason jar, sunlight flare through a wheat field

sections.section: Competitive analysis and where you win

ask.q: Your three or four real competitors — their claim, their strength, and where you win.
What gap are you claiming that nobody else has?

ask.help: An agent that doesn't know this will write copy that pretends otherwise.

sections.section: What this brand will not do

ask.q: List the things this brand will not do.
ask.help: The section agents need most. Write each one so a draft can be checked against it without asking a human. Aim for six or more.
ask.example: We will not discount below 10%, ever, and never sitewide.
